o.text:
Inherited from Proto-Common Turkic *aŋït (“wild duck”). According to Eren, ultimately of onomatopoetic origin and possibly related to Azerbaijani anqırmaq (“to yell, bawl, scream”).
cognates
Cognate with Turkish angut.
Borrowed from Classical Persian دَخْمَه (daxma). Doublet of daxma.
